test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?

options.text: Cybercrime is a problem that only affects individuals and businesses.
Cybersecurity measures cannot alone prevent all forms of cybercrime.
Cybercriminals use phishing attacks to gain access to financial information.
Ransomware attacks are the most common form of cybercrime.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses various cybercrimes and their impact. 
 
• It mentions different preventive measures but doesn't claim they are foolproof.
 
• Cybercriminals develop new techniques, so staying vigilant and informed is crucial.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option (1)** - Cybercrime is a problem that only affects individuals and businesses is incorrect. The passage mentions governments are also affected.
 
• **Option (3) **- Cybercriminals use phishing attacks to gain access to financial information is true based on the information in the passage.
 
• **Option (4) **- Ransomware attacks are the most common form of cybercrime is not mentioned in the passage. The passage says hacking is one of the most common forms.
